data.title: LESSON PLAN FOR MATHEMATICS STANDARD SIX 2026
data.header: OFFICE OF THE PRIME MINISTER, REGIONAL ADMINISTRATION AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT

plan_details.main_competence: Use mathematical language to present ideas or arguments (Part One)
plan_details.specific_competence: Apply the concepts of numbers to communicate ideas and concepts in different contexts.
plan_details.teaching_learning_resources: Exercise books Text books Oral practice video Internet and online sources Charts of numbers Number patterns
plan_details.references: TIE(2019)Mathematics For Primary Schools Pupils Book Standard six. Dar es salaam

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Review place values from thousands to millions, using number charts and place value charts.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Share examples of large numbers they know and discuss how counting beyond millions works.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Counting up to 10,000,000 is performed correctly.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Demonstrate counting sequences, skip counting, and recognizing patterns in large numbers.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Practice counting in steps (e.g., 1 million, 2 million, etc.) and write sequences of large numbers.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Counting up to 10,000,000 is performed correctly.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Provide exercises where students count forward and backward up to 10 million.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Complete counting tasks individually or in groups, then review and discuss.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Counting up to 10,000,000 is performed correctly.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Prepare physical model, use interviews and short quizzes
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Present prepared model, attempt quizzes and participate in interview
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Counting up to 10,000,000 is performed correctly.

plan_details.main_competence: Use mathematical language to present ideas or arguments (Part One)
plan_details.specific_competence: Apply the concepts of numbers to communicate ideas and concepts in different contexts.

plan_details.references: TIE(2019)Mathematics For Primary Schools Pupils Book Standard six. Dar es salaam

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Display large numbers (e.g., 3,456,789) and ask students to read aloud.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Practice reading large numbers aloud in pairs.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Reading numbers up to 10,000,000 is performed correctly.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Explain the rules for reading large numbers, emphasizing groups of three digits.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Read different large numbers correctly and verify with peers.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Reading numbers up to 10,000,000 is performed correctly.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Provide worksheets with written numbers for students to read aloud.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Complete the exercises and check their pronunciation and accuracy.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Reading numbers up to 10,000,000 is performed correctly.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Employ use of flashcards, questions and answers and written assignments
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Respond to flash cards answer oral questions and written assignments
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Reading numbers up to 10,000,000 is performed correctly.

plan_details.main_competence: Use mathematical language to present ideas or arguments (Part One)
plan_details.specific_competence: Apply the concepts of numbers to communicate ideas and concepts in different contexts.
plan_details.main_activity: Writing numbers in numerals up to 10,000,000.
plan_details.teaching_learning_resources: Exercise books Text books Oral practice video Internet and online sources Charts of numbers Number patterns
plan_details.references: TIE(2019)Mathematics For Primary Schools Pupils Book Standard six. Dar es salaam

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Show a number like 5,432,109 and discuss how to write it.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Write given numbers in standard form and share with a partner.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Numbers in numerals up to 10,000,000 are written correctly.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Demonstrate writing large numbers from verbal descriptions.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Convert words or descriptions into numerical form.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Numbers in numerals up to 10,000,000 are written correctly.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Provide exercises for students to convert words into numbers.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Work individually to write numbers and compare answers.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Numbers in numerals up to 10,000,000 are written correctly.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Use portfolios, performance assessment, and questions and answers
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Students present portfolio, answer questions orally and perform tasks
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Numbers in numerals up to 10,000,000 are written correctly.
